title: Play every enabled MC2 creature family in the shared Rust runtime
description:
Execution: gpt-6.1-sol at xhigh. Target: complete single-player MC2 and its reusable Rust engine; multiplayer is separate.

Production rule: deliver the stated behavior through the real game or authoring/control interface, using owner data and existing focused checks. A test, report, fixture, refusal or isolated callback cannot complete this bead. Preserve source defaults and acceptance; add concrete missing capability dependencies instead of weakening them. Keep working code, change APIs with their consumers, and self-verify the positive result with actual commands and limits. No new bot, planning round, framework or test-suite deliverable.

Production outcome and current gap
Child of parent-owned mc-xa7. Cover all 24 enabled class-5 models and their complete production/combat/removal paths. Existing semantic vocabulary has 10; only Bee, Dragon, Archer, Firefly and Skeleton currently advertise complete lifecycle support. Source-disabled models 5/6/7/8/11 stay disabled. This proposal exists because Oliver explicitly requested a complete production backlog; parent tracker writer consumes it, and /tmp proposal retires after integration. It earns no gameplay-delivery credit.

This is a production outcome, not one worker assignment. Its bounded implementation children cover the required behavior; closing only the initially ready children cannot close this epic. Consumer: Oliver and implementation workers. Explicitly requested end-to-end plan, revised 2026-10-23. Retire only when the stated production result works.

Existing models0/2/4/9/19 have explicit source-completion leaves: a current lifecycle predicate alone is not proof of full behavior. Unknown friendly names come from verified owner labels.
